responsibility: Implements the recursive-descent parser for GNU C++. It mediates tokens from the cp lexer, recognizes the C++ grammar across declarations, statements, expressions, templates, concepts, coroutines, OpenMP constructs, and linkage specifications, manages parser state for tentative parsing and template parameter scopes, and invokes semantic builders in the rest of cp/ to construct the front-end trees and deferred parsing artifacts.
same_name_distinction: Contains the parser and lexer-side implementation for recognizing C++ grammar and managing parse-time behavior, including token mediation, tentative parsing state, and implicit-template parsing support. Unlike parser.h, which defines cp_token/cp_lexer/cp_parser structures and related exported interfaces, this file carries out the actual parsing.
